items.text: Invisible magazines now appear correctly when swapping weapons mid‑reload, preventing them from disappearing after holstering.
Uzi loot has been rebalanced: overlapping spawns are prevented, bolt‑action and LR weight reduced to curb loot dilution, and extra ammo added to elite and underwater crates.
Weapons retain their stock‑extended properties while mounted in turrets, regardless of stock configuration.
Drop‑item keybind no longer unintentionally discards the held belt item while the inventory is open.

Generator snapping, shore ice, and roadside waterpipe placement have been fixed to respect terrain features, eliminating corner snapping errors, ice over railway tracks, and waterpipes on road junctions.
Players can now dismount from computer stations even when the space behind the chair is blocked, with added dismount points and a notification when dismount is refused.
Phone conversation UI bugs fixed: opening inventory during a call no longer crashes, and conversation details display correctly after server commands.
Patrol helicopter rockets now appear as the attacker on the death screen when they kill a player.
Combat log now records hits on gull groups, giving feedback on bird encounters.
Triangular prism splash damage now includes grills and triangle hatches, providing more accurate damage coverage.
Boat wake visual effects no longer linger after rejoining a server following a boat's destruction.
Steam description for the Scrap King building skin now correctly reads “upgrade to scrap king”.
Combat logs now display weapons using their short prefab names, making kill feeds clearer and easier to read.

2026-11-03.summary:
### Weapons & Loot
- Invisible magazines now appear correctly when swapping weapons mid‑reload, preventing them from disappearing after holstering.
- Uzi loot has been rebalanced: overlapping spawns are prevented, bolt‑action and LR weight reduced to curb loot dilution, and extra ammo added to elite and underwater crates.
- Weapons retain their stock‑extended properties while mounted in turrets, regardless of stock configuration.
- Drop‑item keybind no longer unintentionally discards the held belt item while the inventory is open.

### Building & Terrain
- Generator snapping, shore ice, and roadside waterpipe placement have been fixed to respect terrain features, eliminating corner snapping errors, ice over railway tracks, and waterpipes on road junctions.

### Player Interaction & UI
- Players can now dismount from computer stations even when the space behind the chair is blocked, with added dismount points and a notification when dismount is refused.
- Phone conversation UI bugs fixed: opening inventory during a call no longer crashes, and conversation details display correctly after server commands.

### Combat
- Patrol helicopter rockets now appear as the attacker on the death screen when they kill a player.
- Combat log now records hits on gull groups, giving feedback on bird encounters.
- Triangular prism splash damage now includes grills and triangle hatches, providing more accurate damage coverage.

### Miscellaneous
- Boat wake visual effects no longer linger after rejoining a server following a boat's destruction.
- Steam description for the Scrap King building skin now correctly reads “upgrade to scrap king”.

### User Interface
- Combat logs now display weapons using their short prefab names, making kill feeds clearer and easier to read.

items.text: Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.
PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.
Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.
Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

2026-11-02.summary:
### Transport
- Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
- Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.

### Combat
- PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
- UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

### AI & Wildlife
- Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
- New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.

### Audio & Effects
- Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.

### Stability
- Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

items.text: Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.
Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.

2026-11-01.summary:
### World Generation
- Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

### Animals & AI
- Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
